fomod.Name: Devotion - Modular Mod PatchHub
fomod.Author: Devotion (PDV)
fomod.Description:
Independent Devotion compatibility options for quest mods and selected non-quest integrations. Each option is gated by its own source plugin and installs only that mod's channel, adapter, or narrow ESL-flagged hook.
Requires: Devotion (PlayerDevotion) with per-mod channel support.
Proof state: package structure, records, scripts, and matrix channels are machine-verified. In-game runtime and player-surface proof remain pending; every option is experimental, not supported.
